name: Volunteer Gwinnett Internship Program
what_you_do: A volunteer internship in a Gwinnett County department. The flyer lists communications, IT, law and public safety. It also lists recreation and water resources. Health and human services are listed too. There are more.
who_can_apply: The county page and flyer say the program is open to high school, undergraduate and graduate students. No ages or grade rules are listed in what was read.
pay_detail: Listed as a volunteer internship. Pay is not stated.
deadline_text: The county page says volunteer internships are available year-round. No deadline is listed.
how_to_apply: Find the listings and apply at VolunteerGwinnett.net. You can also call 770.822.7955. Or write to VolunteerGwinnett@GwinnettCounty.com.
notes: The VolunteerGwinnett.net listings page would not open because of a certificate error. So the open jobs, ages and hours were not read. Ask about the minimum age before you apply. The county page names Muriam Nafees as the contact for volunteer internships.
